name: Proxmox_VE_Node_Network
description: State of this Proxmox VE node's bridges, the virtual switches its guests attach to, asked of the node itself.
technicalNotes:
BatchScript: one /nodes/{node}/network call to this node per interval; any API token may read it.

One instance per bridge, Linux or Open vSwitch (types bridge and OVSBridge). The wildvalue is the bridge name. Physical ports, bonds and VLAN interfaces are not discovered: the node's own SNMP interface monitoring covers its ports with link state, speed, traffic and errors, and Proxmox gives no interface MAC address a switch's topology could join on, so a switch joins the map at the node.

Active is Proxmox's own flag. Healthy is 0 only for a bridge set to start at boot (autostart) that is not active -- the guests on it have lost their network -- so a bridge left down on purpose is not an alert. Ports counts the bridge's ports.

Each instance carries a topology vertex for Proxmox_VE_Cluster_Topology (predef.externalResourceID and predef.externalResourceType), type VirtualSwitch, drawn between the node and the guests on the bridge. The keys are written plain, so where topo.namespace or topo.blacklist is set, which rewrites the TopologySource's keys, discovery stamps none: the instances stay, off the map.

Applies on ProxmoxVE_Node resources the NetScan has not marked unreachable (pve.netscan.reachable). The node is asked directly, at this resource's own hostname, and never through another node: another node would answer for itself. The suite has no addCategory_* PropertySource: the NetScan sets the categories and pve.cluster.role, and the product page lists them for a resource added by hand.

datapoints.name: Active
datapoints.description: 1 when Proxmox reports the bridge active.

datapoints.name: Healthy
datapoints.description: 0 when the bridge is set to start at boot but is not active; 1 otherwise.
datapoints.alertBody:
Bridge ##INSTANCE## on ##HOST## is set to start at boot but is not active: the guests on it have no network.

Status: ##ALERTVALUEDISPLAYSTATUSNAME## (##VALUE##).

This started at ##START##, ##DURATION## ago.

datapoints.name: Ports
datapoints.description: The number of ports configured on the bridge.
